programme.title: Superstars Sunday: Paper Marriage
programme.desc: Boxer Bo is an unlucky gambler, constantly on the look-out for a quick way to make money. He finds marriage is easier and more lucrative than being subjected to bizarre scientific experiments. The lady Jade is completely in love with her boyfriend Peter and gives him all her money when she arrives. Peter convinces Jade to temporarily marry Bo so that she can clear immigration and eventually become his bride. She accepts only to discover that Peter just wanted her money...

programme.title: Robotrix
programme.desc: Selina, a beautiful female cop, who is assigned to bodyguard a middle eastern prince who is staying in Hong Kong. But then, a mad scientist who has transferred his mind into a cyborge which looks human comes and kills Selina, then kidnaps the prince and holds him for ransom. To save the prince and stop the evil scientist-turned killer cyborge, good scientist Dr. Sara and her cyborge assistant Ann transfer Selina's mind into the body of a cyborge that looks just like her. Now Selina, Ann, Dr. Sara and Selina's cop fiance, who has been told Selina survived the shooting and doesn't know she's a cyborge now, must team up to defeat the bad guy...

programme.title: Running Out Of Time
programme.desc: Andy has only 14 days left in his life. He burglars a Diamond Trading Company and hence arouses the attention of a Police Negotiator, Sean...

programme.title: Affectionately Yours
programme.desc: Aran is an honest person. He leads an ordinary life and is quite successful with his business. However, when his girlfriend leaves him, chaos begins. He feels depressed and disheartened. Aran finds his friend Ruddy for comfort. Ruddy's sister Connie has always been interested in Aran so Ruddy and his friend contrive a 'trap' for Aran. Aran is forced to marry Connie. Aran and Connie visit Japan for their honeymoon. It is where Aran learns of the scheme and meets Atsuko who really steals his heart...

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 延續無修音、無剪輯、無劇本的核心底色，助力好歌破圈，並在內容編排、歌曲推薦體系等方面進行煥新升級；邀請了胡夏、姚曉棠、姚弛、王櫟鑫、小鬼-王琳凱、付辛博、劉端端、吉克雋逸...等超強陣容，打造一場全天候的真音樂狂歡派對。

programme.title: E6 - 周杰倫最愛火藥賽開啟
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: E4 - 軍哥乃文遇歐豪成霸道助理
programme.desc: 兩位50+娛樂圈前輩胡軍、李乃文化身為經理人團隊，為具有代表性的年輕後輩藝人擔任經理人，全面負責藝人的行程安排，從接送機、行程對接、妝髮準備到工作陪伴、突發危機處理...等；他們需要動用自己的人生智慧和圈內經驗，為藝人保駕護航。

programme.title: E1 - Jessie J 張靚穎雙強炸場
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演！

programme.title: E20
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭、內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義。

programme.title: E2 - Summer on the Edge
programme.desc: Explore a 1,500-year-old monastery among the dizzying crags of the world-famous Skellig Islands. Spy Manx shearwaters and humpback whales, then chase after pygmy shrews on Clare before heading to the Aran Islands for a peek at an autumn spectacle.

programme.title: E2 - Mountain Worlds
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe’s most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that’s cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: E4 - Mountains
programme.desc: Climb into a realm of thin air and towering rock. Tag along as mythical monkeys battle for a winter food stash, sing along with lemurs in a fruit-filled tree canopy, and watch an aromatic tree bring together blossom and possum in a moonlit tryst.

programme.title: E5 - Boreal
programme.desc: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

programme.title: E6 - Extreme
programme.desc: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

programme.title: E1 - The Wilds of Winter
programme.desc: Endure winter and early spring on the west coast, where animals eke out a chilly existence. Watch red deer battle on windswept Inishvickillane, welcome seal pups amid howling storms on the Inishkea islands, and view the return of the basking sharks.

programme.title: E21
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。
